NewsArticle.Title: Test Application Active
NewsArticle.Content: Dedicated role-players welcome Dark Ages is now accepting applications for role-playing beta testers. Dark Ages, the two year-long anticipated title begins testing in 1999. Dark Ages is accepting the very best role-players to live in the world first. Private beta-testing for talented role-players will be offered on these dates: - January, 1999: Chaos Age - February, 1999: Atavism Age - Spring, 1999: Dark Ages The Dark Ages director will personally screen each applicant's experience and demonstrated talent for role-playing and storytelling. When asked what he's looking for, he said, "Those that know and love the genre; not just of real role-playing culture, but of this world's roots." Visit ['atavism,'](http://www.darkages.com/2000/atavism/index.html) the director's web, to see those roots, then go [HERE](http://www.darkages.com/2000/test/index.html) to apply: [www.darkages.com/test](http://www.darkages.com/2000/test/index.html).
